Rohit Mishra
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
rohit.mishra931@example.com | +91 9502854292

Experienced cloud and DevOps engineer focused on building reliable, automated infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines on Azure. Strong track record delivering infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and operational runbooks to reduce deployment time and improve system stability. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Koramangala only. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Bluefin Logistics — Mar 2025 - Present
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
- Implemented Terraform modules to provision multi-environment Azure infrastructure (networking, AKS, Azure SQL) reducing environment provisioning time from 6 hours to under 30 minutes; authored reusable module library used across 8 teams. (Terraform, Azure)
- Built PowerShell-driven automation for day-2 operations including VM patching, backup verification and alert remediation, decreasing on-call incident resolution time by 35%. (PowerShell, Azure)
- Designed and implemented Azure DevOps pipelines with automated Terraform plan/apply and policy checks, enabling safe gated deployments and reducing failed deployments by 40%. (Terraform, Azure)
- Led knowledge transfer and created Confluence runbooks for deployment, rollback and incident playbooks, improving mean time to recovery (MTTR) documentation adherence across ops teams. (Confluence, Azure)

Paystack India — Aug 2020 - Feb 2025
Cloud Engineer
- Developed and maintained Terraform codebase to manage cloud resources across development and production, standardizing templates and reducing drift; decreased provisioning errors by 50%. (Terraform)
- Automated configuration and application deployments using Ansible playbooks for Linux fleets and integrated with CI pipelines to achieve consistent, repeatable releases; cut manual configuration time by 60%. (Ansible)
- Created PowerShell tooling for cross-team tasks including secrets rotation and Azure resource inventory reports, saving ~10 developer hours/week across the platform team. (PowerShell, Azure)
- Documented operational procedures and created Confluence pages for runbooks, onboarding guides and incident retrospectives, improving team onboarding speed and knowledge retention. (Confluence)

Projects
- Self-service Environment Provisioner: Terraform + Azure DevOps pipeline allowing developers to request ephemeral environments via a Git-based workflow; average provisioning time ~20 minutes. (Terraform, Azure)
- Automated Patch Compliance Reporter: PowerShell scripts scheduled in Azure Automation to report OS patch compliance and generate Confluence summaries for stakeholders. (PowerShell, Confluence)
